rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for general correctness, especially of an answer, method, or procedure.

example.english: The correctness of this answer is very important.
example.traditional: 呢個答案嘅正確性好重要。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 daap3 on3 ge3 zing3 kok3 sing3 hou2 zung6 jiu3

rows.note: Use this for freedom from error when factual, numerical, or measurement precision is the focus.

example.english: We double-checked the correctness of the data.
example.traditional: 我哋再三核對啲數據嘅準確性。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 zoi3 saam1 hat6 deoi3 di1 sou3 geoi3 ge3 zeon2 kok3 sing3

rows.note: Use this when correctness means that information or a statement conforms to the truth or facts.

example.english: The correctness of this information still needs to be verified.
example.traditional: 呢個消息嘅真實性仲有待查證。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 siu1 sik1 ge3 zan1 sat6 sing3 zung6 jau5 doi6 caa4 zing3

rows.note: Use this specifically for conformity with formal rules, regulations, or technical standards.

example.english: This report must first pass a correctness review for regulatory compliance.
example.traditional: 呢份報告要先通過合規性審查。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 jiu3 sin1 tung1 gwo3 hap6 kwai1 sing3 sam2 caa4
